collection.traces: kieker AMQP spool and traces.json as frozen
collection.witnessLogSecretScan: fail-closed raw-text secret scan of auth.log and persistence.log as frozen (modules/teastore/validation/secret_scan.py), except that a JVM stack-frame source location '(<File>.java|kt|scala|groovy:<ASCII digits>)' followed by whitespace or the end of the text, with a key of at most 256 characters, is not an assignment (sweep only; TeaStore relaunch 1 cell 11, 2026-10-03); every other assignment, including a frame-shaped location with any other value or with text glued to its ')', still blocks the cell
collection.witnessLogs: auth.log and persistence.log as frozen (docker logs --since/--until)

design.cellShape: campaign B's cell of the same regime and rate (candidate_sweep_b.cell_timing; the recommender pause is shaped on B's auth-pause cell); only the seeded onset (faultOnsetPhaseOffsetSeconds, faultOnsetSeconds, scoredWindowSeconds), the plan-derived phase floors that follow from it, and for the recommender pause the fault name and target (fault, faultTarget) differ
design.faultDoses: pause on the target for the hold: recommender (off-path) and auth (the sweep's fault, on-path control); the pause target is the allow-list {auth, recommender} of the fault controller
design.noFaultRegimeReusesFrozenPath: no-fault-cost: the frozen no-fault code path (performance probe, resources.json) runs unchanged; the sweep reads its cells as calibration, not cost

omittedRegimes.net-delay: no mechanism without sudo: netem needs root in the target's network namespace and fb14srv5 grants the execution user no passwordless sudo; a docker sidecar sharing the netns needs an image with tc that is not provisioned or digest-pinned on fb14srv5

design.purpose: off-path pause: pause the recommender (not on the login route) with the auth freeze as the on-path control, login-only traffic at 10 and 1 journeys/s, 5 blocks; lanes: the registry's heartbeat-removal log line and the paused container's cgroup CPU (BUDGET_TEASTORE_OFFPATH.md, PLAN_LANES_20261014.md)

pathRelation.auth-freeze: on-path: the login POST calls auth, which calls persistence
pathRelation.recommender-pause: off-path by the code of the pinned SUT (the login POST, the redirect's index page and the services behind them do not call the recommender; webui reaches it only from product, cart and status pages); the epoch records what happens, it does not assume it: a pause that fails journeys is reported as observed (BUDGET_TEASTORE_OFFPATH.md stop rule 4)

fault.probeStamps: every post-revert readiness request (GET /status) is stamped in the receipt's probes list; none starts before the revert command returned (H10: sweep.probePolicy)

path.directEdgePredicate: persistence.parentId == auth.spanId in same original native trace

outcomes.primary: per fault and rate, repeated over blocks: the coordinator-side lane (registry heartbeat-removal line) and the own-silence lane (cgroup CPU of the paused container), each against its no-fault cells

protocolGates.g4ChannelScope: ledger-only (no per-channel in-cell / total counts are recorded)

notEvaluated.P0: harness records no per-service connection counts or emitted-byte observations
notEvaluated.R1: harness records no per-channel recordsAfterWarmup and no per-route readiness map
notEvaluated.R2: fresh project and down -v are enforced by the cell producer, not recorded as a gate input

schedule.drawEncoding: UTF-8(seed || NUL || epoch || NUL || block-NN || NUL || draw-i || NUL || version)

measuredCellPeriodSeconds.source: teastore-traffic-sweep-c-v1 (fb14srv5, 2026-10-11 02:20-05:44Z), consecutive runtime-journal recordedAt gaps over its 36 cells (all rates and regimes); the per-(regime, rate) means below are those of the cells this epoch repeats

timing.drainAllowanceRule: fault cells: a journey that STARTS in [readiness, readiness + requestTimeoutSeconds + 2 s) may fail without invalidating the cell; it is recorded (count and ids in candidate-validation.json) and excluded from the zero-failure rule and from the scored population; no-fault cells have none

faultHarness.appliesTo: fault cells only (timing.faultHarness is null in a no-fault cell)
faultHarness.h10: no readiness probe from the fault onset (the onset command's issue) to the later of the scored window's end and the revert command's return; the producer refuses to probe earlier, records the window in sweep.probePolicy, and the validator rejects any probe that starts inside it
faultHarness.h4: sweep.freezeStamps: pause = the Docker pause and unpause events of the target container (event time in ns, mapped to the cell's monotonic offsets by linear interpolation between the barrier and the collection instant) beside the command stamps; throttle = the command-issued and command-returned stamps plus the applied-state readback stamps; both = one readback stamp pair per target-state sample
faultHarness.h4Failure: record, don't block (protocol decision 69): a failed or contradictory Docker events query or freeze-stamp check leaves the cell valid; the record carries status 'missing', every reason in failures and their number in failureCount, and the reader falls back to [onset command issued, onset command returned].  H10 stays blocking.

timing.faultOnsetPhaseSelectorEncoding: stratum order: UTF-8(seed || NUL || epoch || NUL || regime || NUL || rate token || NUL || onset-stratum || NUL || stratum); position: UTF-8(seed || NUL || epoch || NUL || runId || NUL || onset-phase)
timing.holdRule: revert issued after the last hold sample, taken >= hold after the first post-command sample
timing.minimumActualStartsByPhaseRule: max(1, ceil(protocol_gates.FLOOR x scheduled slots in the phase)); before = slots before onset, during = slots in [onset, onset + hold), after = slots from onset + hold + postRecoveryAllowanceSeconds

traceCompleteness.incompleteJourney: any record of the journey's native trace(s) carries a correlation error (missing or ambiguous parent, conflicting native identity), the trace has an execution-order-index gap or a repeated (message, trace, eoi/ess) identity, or it lacks the required auth->persistence edge; traces are attributed to journeys by the auth native-trace bridge
traceCompleteness.source: research/PROTOCOL_DRAFT_20261002.md decision 25 (shared by the three sweeps)
traceCompleteness.unattributable: an incomplete native trace no journey's bridge names is one cluster; inside window I by the logging time of all its defective records: recorded; otherwise it counts as one incomplete journey in window II
traceCompleteness.windowI: fault cells: start in [onset command issued, readiness + drainAllowanceSeconds): recorded as fault effect, never blocking
traceCompleteness.windowII: pre-onset, after the drain window, and every no-fault cell: block only if incomplete journeys > max(1, floor(fraction x successful journeys there))

workload.concurrencyRule: ceil(1.6 x max rate x request timeout)
workload.population: login only (one POST /loginAction per journey; the 302 to / is followed)
workload.requestTimeoutSource: workload/fixed_load.py --timeout default (the frozen cell runner passes none)
